lines.en: Amara, I am almost sure the track is closed today. The main gate was completely blocked with fences when I passed.
lines.pt: Amara, tenho quase certeza de que a pista está fechada hoje. O portão principal estava completamente bloqueado por cercas quando passei.

lines.en: Really? I was nearly there when you called, and nobody stopped me. Maybe they only closed the north entrance.
lines.pt: Sério? Eu estava quase chegando quando você ligou, e ninguém me parou. Talvez só tenham fechado a entrada norte.

lines.en: That would be quite a relief. I have trained for the marathon for months, and my legs feel almost ready.
lines.pt: Seria um alívio e tanto. Treino para a maratona há meses, e minhas pernas já parecem quase prontas.

lines.en: Do not worry. The lake path is not completely empty, but it is quiet enough for a good run.
lines.pt: Não se preocupe. O caminho do lago não está completamente vazio, mas é tranquilo o bastante para uma boa corrida.

lines.en: Good idea. Last week I ran nearly ten kilometres there, and the view of the skyline was quite impressive.
lines.pt: Boa ideia. Semana passada corri quase dez quilômetros lá, e a vista do horizonte era bem impressionante.

lines.en: I know. Yesterday it rained, so the grass was soaked, and my shoes were completely wet after five minutes.
lines.pt: Eu sei. Ontem choveu, então a grama estava encharcada, e meus tênis ficaram totalmente molhados em cinco minutos.

lines.en: Oh no. Did you finish the run anyway, or did you give up because of the mud and the cold?
lines.pt: Ah, não. Você terminou a corrida mesmo assim, ou desistiu por causa da lama e do frio?

lines.en: I finished. It took me nearly an hour, which is slow, but I felt almost proud when I got home.
lines.pt: Terminei. Levei quase uma hora, o que é lento, mas me senti quase orgulhosa ao chegar em casa.

lines.en: That is the spirit. Honestly, I am quite nervous about the race, because the last part is completely uphill.
lines.pt: Esse é o espírito. Sinceramente, estou bem nervosa com a prova, porque a última parte é completamente em subida.

lines.en: Then we should practise on a hill this weekend. I know a street near my flat that is almost as steep.
lines.pt: Então devemos treinar numa ladeira neste fim de semana. Conheço uma rua perto do meu apartamento que é quase igual de íngreme.

lines.en: Perfect. If we start at seven, we will be back before the park gets busy, and I will buy the coffee.
lines.pt: Perfeito. Se começarmos às sete, voltaremos antes de o parque encher, e eu pago o café.

facts.label: Quão perto está?
facts.sub: Quase, bem, totalmente: o advérbio mede o grau.

facts.label: quase, perto de
facts.sub: Use antes do verbo, do adjetivo ou do número: I almost forgot, nearly ten kilometres. Eles dizem que algo chegou perto, mas não aconteceu totalmente.

facts.label: totalmente
facts.sub: Completely dá a ideia de total e vai com adjetivos como blocked, empty, wet e different. Não use very antes dele: completely wet, nunca very completely wet.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Almost and nearly are very close in meaning.
items.why: Both mean close to, but not quite.

items.s: Completely is used to say something is partial.
Quite can go before a or an: quite a relief.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Almost and nearly are very close in meaning. → Verdadeiro (Both mean close to, but not quite.)
Completely is used to say something is partial. → Falso (Completely means total.)
Quite can go before a or an: quite a relief. → Verdadeiro (Yes, quite a + noun.)

pages.title: Almost, nearly, quite: how close is it? · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a bright Saturday in Atlanta. Elena wants to run before the park is crowded. She is training for a marathon. Workers are repairing some paths. Her friend Zoe is on her way. They have a lot to discuss.

“Zoe, I am almost sure the track is closed today. The main gate was completely blocked with fences when I passed.” says Elena. “Really? I was nearly there when you called, and nobody stopped me. Maybe they only closed the north entrance.” says Zoe. “That would be quite a relief. I have trained for the marathon for months, and my legs feel almost ready.” says Elena.
